run_note: The operator's folder was named run, copied into the snapshot ahead of the run and identical to the package. The VM was restored to the snapshot taken before run 2, which still held the logged-out first attempt's session file (void-2) and an empty memory folder; nothing from run 2 was on the machine, and the agent never opened either. The client ran in its auto permission mode and never compacted the main session; the operator sent nothing after the fixed first message, and closed the client the next morning, after the delivery. Seven of the 145 subagents had a response stopped by the safety classifier, and the client switched each of them to claude-sonnet-5; those turns produced 307,988 of the run's output tokens and US$ 6.80 of its US$ 119.07, and their file edits went to scratch copies, not to the delivery. The delivery itself, code, report and findings index, was written by Claude Sonnet 5.5 in the main session, which never switched, so the run stands (PROTOCOL §3), as runs 1 and 2 did.
